{{Quote|I'm sorry, Master, but the beacon still isn't transmitting.|Lari Oll, to Master Yoda|<ref name="loe" />}}
'''Lari Oll''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served as a communications [[Technician/Legends|technician]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Oll was on duty in the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Jedi Temple communication center]] when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attacked]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Under the supervision of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], Oll attempted to send a message to recall all available Jedi to Coruscant; however, she was unable to break through the Separatists' [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|If one of our starfighters could get past the Separatist blockade, there might be a way of relaying a message through the HoloNet.''"<br />"''Already considered that, Master Tiin has. Attempt to recall Jedi from Belderone, Tythe, and other worlds, he will.|Lari Oll and Yoda|<ref name="loe" />}}
[[File:BattleOfCoruscant-EGTW.png|thumb|300px|right|The Separatists' attack on Coruscant]]
Lari Oll was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="loe" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]] of the war, Oll was serving as a communications [[Technician/Legends|technician]]<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|II|409|Oll, Lari}}</ref> in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She was on duty when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched an [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack]] on Coruscant. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] wanted to recall all available Jedi to Coruscant; however, due to the attack, the Jedi were unable to communicate over the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], so they resorted to using the [[Jedi beacon/Legends|Jedi beacon]].<ref name="loe" />

In the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Jedi Temple communication center]], Oll attempted to send a message out using the beacon. Unable to break through the Separatists' intense signal [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]], Oll suggested to Yoda that if one of the Jedi [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] could get through the Separatist [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] around the planet, they might be able to send a message through the HoloNet. Yoda informed Oll that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] was already in the process of attempting to get past the enemy [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to recall Jedi. On Yoda's command, Oll [[Comm unit/Legends|commed]] Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]; however, the connection was unclear due to the defensive [[Planetary shield/Legends|shields]] that had been raised. Oll then attempted to comm Master [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] to no avail.<ref name="loe" />

==Personality and traits==
Lari Oll was a [[brown]]-haired Jedi who had reached the rank of Jedi Knight by the final stages of the Clone Wars.<ref name="loe" />

==Powers and abilities==
Serving as a communications technician in the Jedi Temple,<ref name="cswe" /> Oll was capable with the Temple's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] and communications systems.<ref name="loe" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lari Oll first appeared in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="loe" />
